doc: expr — the expression language of bindings (view-data-files §4). One AST, two notations: combinator functions in code, CEL-compatible strings in data files. Expressions have no side effects, always terminate, are typed, and are evaluated synchronously by native code; an error yields the type's default value and a diagnostic, never an exception.
